skeleton.extensionRule: Preserve all 26 v1 bone names, parents and rest transforms. Add finger joints under hand_l/hand_r; no reparenting or re-rolling existing joints. Record any incompatible change under a new major contract.
skeleton.handFrames: Bone local +Y follows wrist to knuckles; +Z points into the palm. Use the measured rest matrices, not inferred world Euler rotations.

mounts.placement: Discrete validated cells in a parent surface frame, with a bounded authored depth offset; no unrestricted world dragging.
mounts.ownership: Each item has one owner. Removing an owner removes its children from the active assembly; undo restores the subtree. Empty clothing is always complete.
mounts.coverage: Optional optimisation only after complete exposed body validation; never use coverage masks to hide missing source surfaces.
mounts.fitStatus: Conventions fixed; mount dimensions/transforms are authored and validated with CM5-CM7 assets.

budget.rule: Count the actual assembled combination, including repeated items and hidden loaded geometry. These allocations are targets, not measurements or permission to exceed the cap.
